title: Conservation of Energy, Efficiency and Energy Resources

flashcard_questions.q: The principle that energy cannot be created or destroyed — only transferred between stores or dissipated to the surroundings.
A collection of objects where no energy can enter or leave — the total energy remains constant.
Energy that has spread out to the thermal energy store of the surroundings and is no longer useful.

flashcard_questions.a: Energy transferred during a process that is not part of the intended output — it reduces the efficiency of the device.
A measure of how much of the input energy is usefully transferred — calculated as useful output divided by total input, expressed as a decimal or percentage.
